description: This source file implements APIs for managing external SD Card properties within a TR-069 host interface, including retrieving SD card information such as capacity, manufacturer, model, serial number, status, and other attributes. It includes class definitions, singleton pattern implementation, and platform-specific code for SD card property retrieval.

classes.name: hostIf_STBServiceXSDCard
classes.description: Class providing interface to get and set SD Card properties, implemented as a singleton.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of hostIf_STBServiceXSDCard.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Deletes the singleton instance of hostIf_STBServiceXSDCard.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles get requests for SD Card properties based on parameter name.

methods.name: getCapacity
methods.description: Retrieves SD Card capacity in MB.

methods.name: getLifeElapsed
methods.description: Retrieves SD Card life elapsed percentage.

methods.name: getTSBQualified
methods.description: Retrieves whether SD Card is TSB qualified.
